gameDescriptionHtml:
The indie rhythm game “MUSYNX” returns!

Back to classic fundamentals, delivering a pure and authentic rhythm gameplay experience.

Game Features

  • Classic Falling-Note Rhythm Mode – Featuring traditional 4-lane and 6-lane falling-note gameplay, combined with a clear and intuitive interface, allowing you to smoothly perform complex tracks and unleash the thrill of rhythm!
  • Continuously Expanding Music Library – 35 original tracks available at launch. At least 25 additional songs will be added via free DLC within the first six months.
  • Authentic Instrument Key Feedback – Each note includes dedicated instrument sound effects, paired with low-latency audio technology. No more monotonous tick sounds – experience true musical performance.
  • Brand-New 2-Lane Mode – Easy to Start – Play with just two fingers and quickly enjoy the fun of rhythm tapping. Even beginners can easily step into the world of rhythm!
  • 9 Difficulty Variations for Every Skill Level – Each track includes 2-key / 4-key / 6-key layouts x three difficulty levels. Whether you’re a newcomer or a rhythm master, there’s always a chart for you.
  • Professional Accuracy Indicator & Performance Statistics – Adjustable timing feedback and detailed result analysis help dedicated players continuously push their limits.
  • Fast Access – Jump Straight into Gameplay – Enter a song in as fast as 10 seconds after launching the game. No waiting, just pure rhythm action!
  • High-Quality Visuals with 4K Support – A sleek sci-fi military-inspired visual design combined with 4K ultra-high-definition graphics delivers an immersive and premium visual experience.
